answer: Each person proves once, with a zero-knowledge proof, that they hold a unique real-world credential, revealing nothing but uniqueness, and receives a fresh unlinkable pearl for every epoch. One credential yields exactly one lantern per epoch, so a single document can never spawn a Sybil farm, and proofs from different epochs cannot be linked to reveal who is who. Stealing or buying thousands of real credentials costs far more than any epoch reward, and a credential reported stolen is struck from the violet registry, killing every identity derived from it at once.
